verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own Search API docs list "domain filtering" as a core feature and say results come "with controls for domains," so this is a first-party capability for restricting search results by domain. The evidence consists of overview-level mentions only. Missing for 10: parameter-level documentation (e.g., the filter field name and syntax), explicit confirmation that both allowlist (restrict) and denylist (exclude) modes are supported, whether domain filtering also applies to the Sonar/Agent answer endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
